bullets.text: Heavy overnight rain in Chennai flooded residential areas including Velachery checkpost, and the office should monitor relief operations.
Bodies of two schoolboys who drowned in Puzhal Lake were recovered, and local authorities should watch for water safety compliance.
A hut fire in Poonamallee caused livestock deaths, and district officials should provide immediate relief to affected residents.
A University of Madras study linked urban growth to rising flood risk in Chennai, and the office should review regional drainage plans.
One entrance to Puzhuthivakkam MRTS station remains closed since March, and officials should coordinate with railway authorities to expedite opening.
Inflow has increased to Puzhal and Poondi lakes due to heavy rains, and the district team must closely monitor reservoir levels.
Commuters at the Avadi temporary bus terminus face hardships due to poor civic amenities, and CMDA should accelerate construction.
Police traced a missing eight-year-old girl from Sriperumbudur to a children's home, and local child welfare offices should verify her care.
Chennai Mayor Priya condemned defamatory AI-generated videos on social media, and the IT department should review platform accountability measures.
Equinix India plans to expand its data centre capacity to 70 MW, and the digital services office should facilitate necessary clearances.
